recommendation: Keep the commit as-is. It completes the Published clarification in active CodeSystem source and removes the remaining stale in-tree wording without broadening the issue scope.
issue_request: FHIR-16742 was Published with a Persuasive with Modification resolution for CodeSystem.count. It asked to replace wording that said compositional code systems count base/primitive concepts with wording that says the basis is defined by the system steward, and to add a comment that the count is usually the total number of enumerated codes published as part of the code system.
initial_application: The Jira record says the issue was applied in svn revision 14725. Current active CodeSystem source already carried the steward-defined definition, but the requested enumerated-code comment was absent and source/codesystem/codesystem.svg still contained the old base/primitive title text.
additional_context: source/fhir.ini actively maps codesystem to the CodeSystem resource, so source/codesystem/structuredefinition-CodeSystem.xml is in current build scope. Searches found no prior combined-branch commit for FHIR-16742, no related Jira issue beyond FHIR-16742, and no Zulip or Confluence discussion that changed the Published resolution. The SVG edit is included only alongside the authoritative XML change because the diagram title was stale generated-looking source.
reconciliation: Added the missing comment sentence to CodeSystem.count in source/codesystem/structuredefinition-CodeSystem.xml and synchronized the CodeSystem SVG title with the current steward-defined definition.
source_changes: source/codesystem/structuredefinition-CodeSystem.xml: appended the requested comment that CodeSystem.count is usually the total number of enumerated codes published as part of the code system.
source/codesystem/codesystem.svg: updated the CodeSystem.count title to the current steward-defined wording so the old base/primitive text no longer remains in the diagram source.
